Dear Mr. Hewitt

Does summer give you the urge to travel? Whether it’s a city break, a beach vacation or a round trip – traveling rewards you with unforgettable impressions and experiences. Your UBS Visa Prepaid or Credit Card is the ideal companion. 

Use your Visa card abroad now, and with a bit of luck, you could be in for a special treat. Take part in our exclusive contest and thanks to Visa, you could win 10× 2 tickets for the NFL London Game between the Jacksonville Jaguars and the Los Angeles Rams at the legendary Wembley Stadium in London. 

Best of all, every Visa card payment abroad of CHF 50 or more is a chance to win until 31 August 2025.
